findings.summary: Repair ambiguous reassessment option, unsupported U18 carrying motion, between-versus-goal-side position wording, and U7 sequence language.

All eight sequence activities repeat scan/look, compare/notice, choose/name. Meaningful variety is lower than five-type schema coverage suggests; U15/U18 need more scene-specific decisions for stronger age progression.
Title Choose the open support, not the closer one implies lane openness established only by defender distance. Rename Compare the support options.
Jersey-colour distractor is implausible, permitting a correct choice without a hockey read.
Loose puck only 0.54 m from 2 needs actual renderer verification to support perceptible possession distinction.

No rim/wall substitution occurs. Corrected negative-x attack, outside-circle example and puck-owner movement are consistent. Geometry/content review does not certify player perception, developmental suitability or coaching admission.
